build: profiling with full debug information; no forced frame pointers; diagnostics disabled

caller_decode.reason: Caller stacks are incomplete; both caller partitions are rejected. Self report recovers direct instruction attribution independently of unwinding.

limits: Self sample fractions are diagnostic estimates, not production speedup predictions.
Changed commit and build flags prevent attributing differences from the earlier profile to frame pointers or private ownership alone.
Samples do not establish dynamic copy sizes, allocation counts, avoidability, or the cost of specific field moves.
Endpoint CPU observations and complete-generation command counts have different windows; no CPU-per-command estimate is calculated.
Runqueue delay is measured separately from CPU; the remaining elapsed interval is not assigned to a blocking cause.
No diagnostic throughput, latency, or resource delta is retained as production qualification.
